parole.testo: Earlier form Russ from German Russe etc., from Old East Slavic Русь (Rusĭ). More recent use influenced by Russian Русь (Rusʹ), from Old East Slavic Русь (Rusĭ). Use with macron was probably influenced by the transliteration of Arabic رُوس (rūs). Compare Russ, Russian, Russie, Russniak, Rusyn, Ruthen

parole.significato: Of or relating to the Russians.
parole.testo: From German Russe etc., from Old East Slavic Русь (Rusĭ). Compare more recent Rus.
